highlights: US core inflation cooled to 3.5% in June, dimming case for Fed rate hike and boosting risk-on sentiment across equities.
Oil surged over 9% after Trump reimposed Iran blockade, with fresh US strikes on Iran fueling inflation fears and geopolitical risk.
IBM stock tumbled 25% on surprise earnings that reignited AI fears, while Nvidia remained Morgan Stanley's top pick despite headwinds.
China reported lowest GDP growth in more than 3 years, with rare-earth curbs threatening $6.5 trillion in global supply chains.
Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan posted historic profits on roaring Wall Street activity and mega AI deals like SpaceX.
SpaceX stock fizzled to close just $1 above IPO price weeks after debut, while Stripe/Advent offered $53 billion for PayPal.
BHP iron ore workers staged first strike since 2000, and India increased fuel export levies as global supply tightened.
Asian gas prices near four-month high on Mideast tensions, and nickel hit three-week high on Indonesia supply risks.
Paramount-Warner Bros. $110 billion deal faces lawsuit from 12 states, while 12 states also block the merger.
Apple stock has been flying but an expert says it's time to sell, while AMD looks set for a beat-and-raise quarter on AI server demand.

risks.title: Geopolitical escalation in Middle East (US-Iran)
risks.mitigation: Increase exposure to energy stocks and commodities (oil, gas, tanker shipping). Hedge with gold or inflation-protected bonds. Reduce exposure to sectors sensitive to oil price spikes (airlines, consumer discretionary).

risks.title: China rare-earth export curbs and economic slowdown
risks.mitigation: Diversify supply chains away from China for rare-earth dependent industries (tech, defense, EVs). Monitor China GDP data and policy responses. Consider investing in non-China rare-earth miners or recycling companies.

risks.title: AI trade correction after IBM's 25% plunge
risks.mitigation: Rotate from high-multiple AI stocks with no earnings to those with proven revenue (Nvidia, AMD, ASML). Use options to hedge downside in AI ETFs. Focus on companies with beat-and-raise potential.

risks.title: Inflation reacceleration from energy spike
risks.mitigation: Lock in fixed-rate debt, increase allocation to TIPS and commodities. Reduce duration in bond portfolios. Favor value stocks over growth if inflation expectations rise.

risks.title: Labor strikes in mining and energy
risks.mitigation: Monitor BHP iron ore strike and potential supply disruptions. Consider long positions in alternative iron ore producers or steel companies with diversified supply. Avoid overexposure to single-commodity miners.

risks.title: Regulatory pushback on mega M&A (Paramount-Warner Bros.)
risks.mitigation: Avoid speculative positions in merger arbitrage for media deals facing antitrust challenges. Favor companies with clear regulatory paths or smaller bolt-on acquisitions.

risks.title: SpaceX IPO underperformance and broader IPO market risk
risks.mitigation: Be selective in IPO allocations, focusing on companies with strong fundamentals and clear growth paths. Avoid chasing hype-driven IPOs. Consider post-IPO stabilization before entry.

risks.title: Korea leveraged ETF regulation and Asian market volatility
risks.mitigation: Reduce exposure to Korean leveraged ETFs and related derivatives. Monitor regulatory developments. Diversify Asian equity exposure across markets with less regulatory risk.

risks.title: Telstra service issues and rural infrastructure gaps
risks.mitigation: For telecom investors, monitor regulatory pressure and customer churn. Consider infrastructure funds focused on rural broadband as a long-term opportunity.

risks.title: Lucid bankruptcy/take-private risk
risks.mitigation: Avoid EV startups with weak balance sheets. Focus on established players (Tesla) or those with strong cash positions. Monitor Lucid's funding situation closely.
